source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 7 exercise (PDF 191-193, key PDF 226).

blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 8 short (mukhtasar) aur 5 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har sawal ke saath bracket mein likha hai ke us ka jawab kis lesson mein hai; wahan Roman Urdu lesson mein self-check ke taur par jawab diya gaya hai.

items: In mein se kaunsi cheez aam taur par Terms of Use ki common clauses (aam shartein) mein shamil NAHI hoti? (a) User obligations (b) Privacy and data use (c) Product advertising (d) Termination of service

Terms of Use mein “Limitations of Liability” clause aam taur par kya karti hai? (a) Company har masle ki poori zimmedari leti hai (b) Kuch ghalat ho jaye to company ki zimmedari mehdood karti hai (c) Har nuqsan par user ko huqooq deti hai (d) Har waqt service chalne ki guarantee deti hai
In mein se kaunsa nuqsan deh software chupke se aap ke computer ya phone ki activities ki nigrani karta hai? (a) Spam (b) Cookies (c) Spyware (d) Pharming
Kaunsa khatra user ko us ke ilm ke baghair jaali websites par bhej deta hai? (a) Phishing (b) Spam (c) Spyware (d) Pharming

Digital divide taleem par kaise asar dalta hai? (a) Sab students ki parhai behtar karta hai (b) Taleem par koi asar nahi (c) Digital learning resources tak rasai mein na-barabari paida karta hai (d) Riwayati tareeqa-e-tadrees ko bekaar kar deta hai
Data provenance se kya murad hai? (a) Maloomat tak pohanchne ki qeemat (b) Data ki history aur origin (c) Source ki maqbooliyat (d) Maloomat ka kai zabanon mein tarjuma

Maloomat parakhte waqt bias samajhna kyun zaroori hai? (a) Mukhalif nuqta-e-nazar nazar andaz karne ke liye (b) Source ke viewpoint ya agenda ko pehchan kar us ka hisab rakhne ke liye (c) Sab sources ko barabar qabil-e-aitbaar manne ke liye (d) Maloomat ko parakhne se bilkul bachne ke liye
In mein se muashre par computing systems ka musbat asar kaunsa hai? (a) Ghalat maloomat ka zyada phailna (b) Maloomat tak behtar rasai (c) Privacy ki fikr (d) Technology tak na-barabar rasai

Maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kya shamil hai? (a) Ijazat ke baghair content copy karna (b) Copyright ka ehtaram aur plagiarism se bachna (c) Maloomat share karte waqt data sources nazar andaz karna (d) Reports mein ghair tasdeeq shuda maloomat istemal karna

In mein se kaunsa kaam zimmedarana digital rawayya NAHI? (a) Personal data sirf secure websites par dena (b) Social media par jhooti maloomat phailana (c) Online doosron ki privacy ka ehtaram (d) Mashkook online activities ki report karna
Users ke liye Terms of Use samajhna kyun zaroori hai? (jawab: 7.1.1)
Phishing aur pharming mein farq bataiye. (jawab: Pharming)
Cookies privacy ke liye faidemand bhi aur dakhal dene wali bhi kaise hain? Har ek ki misal dein. (jawab: 7.2.1.3)
Samaji aur civic participation par digital divide ke do asar bataiye. (jawab: kitab ka 7.1.2.3)
Information sources parakhne ke aham qadam kya hain? (jawab: 7.4.1)
Computing systems ne muashre mein communication ko kaise mutasir kiya? (jawab: 7.5.1)
Responsible data sharing maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kaise madad karti hai? (jawab: 7.6.2.1)
Online khatre pehchanne aur cybersecurity ke khatron se bachne ke do tareeqe bataiye. (jawab: 7.2.4.4)
Terms of Use ki common clauses samjhaiye aur bataiye ke yeh provider aur user dono ko kaise bachati hain. (jawab: 7.1.2)
Digital divide ko bridge karne ka tasawwur samjhaiye aur is masle mein government initiatives ka kirdar bataiye, Pakistan ki misalon ke saath. (jawab: 7.3.3)
Critical thinking skills maloomat ke zimmedarana istemal mein kaise madad deti hain? Asal zindagi ki misalein dein. (jawab: 7.4.1.5)
Digital mahaul mein mil kar masle hal karne ki ahmiyat bataiye aur misalon se samjhaiye ke human-machine collaboration ise kaise behtar banata hai. (jawab: 7.6.4.1)
Accessible digital content ka tasawwur samjhaiye aur maazoor afraad ki digital shamooliyat ki tadabeer bataiye. (jawab: 7.6.5.1)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answer key (safha 223) Unit 7 ke sawal 1 se 6 ke ghalat jawab deti hai: 1 b, 2 a, 3 a, 4 c, 5 b, 6 c. Chapter ke text ke mutabiq sahi jawab hain: 1 (c), 2 (b), 3 (c), 4 (d), 5 (c), 6 (b). Maslan sawal 3 ka jawab Spyware hai, kyunke spam to unwanted messages hain, software nahi; aur sawal 4 ka jawab Pharming hai, kyunke text kehta hai ke pharming hi user ko jaali website par bhejti hai. Sawal 7 se 10 ke jawab (b) key mein sahi hain. Is ke ilawa kitab mein sawal 1 ka option (c) “©” chhapa hai; yeh option (c) hai.

items: MCQs ke sahi jawab: 1c 2b 3c 4d 5c 6b 7b 8b 9b 10b; kitab ki key sirf 7 se 10 mein sahi hai.
